spec.interval: Underlying real C within measured C +/-1second.
spec.bound: EMA convex recurrence alpha=2/(1+factor*C/dt). Across interval, abs(dEMA/dC)<=m*price_span*maxabs(dalpha/dC); max at C_lower. A contact root is impossible if abs(residual_at_C)>bound+1e-7.
spec.scope: Conservative necessary condition only; failure to exclude is not a root. Additional audit registered after exact-contact result, no fit or validation.
